firmware.title: Android System Update (April 2016)
firmware.description: This software update will upgrade your device to the April 2016 release of Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow, which improves security and stability and fixes bugs. Downloading updates over a mobile network or while roaming may cause additional charges.
